problem_statement: Fix redact_keys() so it recursively removes every object member whose key exactly matches a string in blocked. Traverse objects at every depth, including objects inside arrays; preserve all unblocked object members in their original order, preserve array positions and order, and leave scalar values unchanged even when their text equals a blocked key. Empty objects and arrays remain present when their containing key is not blocked, a scalar root is returned unchanged, matching is case-sensitive, and an empty blocked list changes nothing.
